title: Granola media slot
description: A frame for an image, video or screenshot that crops it like object-fit: cover, and shows a plain token-coloured placeholder (warm grey, oat card, soft lime wash, ink or a two-tone art field) while it's empty.
notes: size, aspect ratio and radius come from className
name: granola-media

props.name: children
props.description: the real image, video or screenshot; it is cropped to the frame like object-fit: cover

props.name: tone
props.description:
the placeholder surface while no media is given: muted (warm grey) · oat (the card surface,
with a hairline) · glow (a soft wash from highlight to glow) · ink (dark) · field (a wide
two-tone highlight and lilac field for full-bleed art)

props.name: className
props.description: size, aspect ratio, radius and shadow of the frame
